When edit knowledge and markdown the markdown must be rendered and not plain. Replace the md editor with a rich text md editor. Also the knowledge chips / notes cards in light mode are a bit too dark / dim

The plan should be expndable / openable in a pop up window. Show the view plan in this format. Don't show the plan inside the planning chat C:\Users\athenkosi.hlubi\AppData\Local\Packages\MicrosoftWindows.Client.Core_cw5n1h2txyewy\TempState\ScreenClip\{7363E41C-AF3A-4F80-8DC3-7E6E458B3541}.png
